- {{llm_hist.n_success}} of {{llm_hist.n_cases}} cases succeeded; {{llm_hist.failure_counts.invocation_error}} calls failed with HTTP 429 quota errors and {{llm_hist.failure_counts.wrong_abstention}} answerable case was refused.
- It reported `abstention_correct` {{llm_hist.mean_abstention_correct|.1f}} against v2's {{cmp.llm_hist.abstention_correct.baseline|.1f}}: the model answered "I don't know." on all {{llm_hist.n_unanswerable|word}} unanswerable cases. That rests on {{llm_hist.n_unanswerable|word}} cases.
- Its `groundedness` of {{llm_hist.mean_groundedness|.1f}} averaged only the {{llm_hist.n_grounded}} cases that produced a claim (the failed and refused cases were dropped), against v2's {{cmp.llm_hist.groundedness.baseline|.4f}} over 22, and v2's figure came from the citation-placement bug fixed here (v2 now scores {{v2.mean_groundedness|.1f}}). There was no measured grounding gain.
- Its mean latency of {{llm_hist.mean_latency_s|.1f}} s per case included the client's own 5 s pacing and the retry sleeps on 429 responses, which now stay out of the timer.
- Its token mean ({{llm_hist.mean_total_tokens|.0f}} per case) mixed API counts with character estimates for the failed calls, and the comparison set it against a character estimate of question and answer for the extractive system ({{cmp.llm_hist.total_tokens.baseline|.0f}}), which makes no LLM call. The two are not comparable, and the gate no longer issues a token verdict across different token sources.
